title: The label beats the fastest layout
hook: Which layout follows the shown flat-dry instruction?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts

recall.question: A sweater's label says dry flat. The quickest layout hangs everything on the line. What should you settle first?
options: Hang it with the rest, since the fastest layout wins
Lay it flat, then fit the rest around it
Hang it, but on a wider hanger
recall.why: The label's instruction comes first; a convenient layout does not override it. Choose a compatible method, then optimise the space around it.
